verdict.rationale: Cactus runs a hosted platform API for data generation, fine-tuning jobs and uploads, so webhook event subscriptions (for example, job-completion callbacks) are a fair ask for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions webhooks, callbacks or event subscriptions. The documented API covers only request-style endpoints such as POST /generations, POST /tool_schemas, GET /billing and the reserve/PUT/complete upload flow.
